author: Ari Koslow
title: Sal Frelick suffers shoulder injury Friday
desc: Sal Frelick left Friday's game against the Marlins due to right shoulder soreness.
impact: Frelick will be further evaluated. He is day-to-day going into the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Javier Baez (ankle) takes live BP
desc: Javier Baez took live batting practice.
impact: Baez is scheduled to complete a return to play baserunning session on Saturday. He is working his way back from a high-grade ankle sprain that has had him sidelined since the end of April.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Pooser traded to Cardinals
desc: The Cardinals acquired RHP Trey Pooser from the Rays for RHP Chris Raycroft.
impact: Pooser is the player to be named later in last month's deal that sent Chris Raycroft to the Rays. He was in High-A in the Rays organization.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax struggles in start Friday
desc: Griffin Jax allowed seven runs on eight hits and one walk while striking out six over five innings in the first game of Friday's doubleheader against the Boston Red Sox, taking the loss in a 10-0 defeat.
impact: Jax turned in his worst outing of the season, allowing a season-high seven earned runs. The lone bright spot was that he still recorded six strikeouts, helping soften the fantasy impact of the rough start. He now owns a 4.08 ERA and 1.27 WHIP across 75 innings this season and is scheduled to make his next start on Wednesday against the Toronto Blue Jays.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Enrique Hernandez (oblique) begins rehab assignment Friday
desc: Enrique Hernandez began his rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Hernandez joined Triple-A Oklahoma City. He is batting second and starting at third base on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Maikel Garcia (hand) to be re-evaluated Sunday
desc: Maikel Garcia is scheduled to be re-evaluated on Sunday.
impact: Garcia resumed swinging over the All-Star break. He could ramp up his hitting progression if all goes well.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Estevez (shoulder) starts throwing program Friday
desc: Carlos Estevez started a throwing program on Friday.
impact: Estevez had been shut down since July 1. He is looking at a potential return in late August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Seabold (lat) continuing rehab
desc: Connor Seabold is continuing his rehab in Arizona.
impact: Seabold suffered a strain on June 30. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kris Bubic (elbow/shoulder) could begin throwing program next week
desc: Kris Bubic could begin a new throwing program next week.
impact: Bubic has been shut down since he received a cortisone shot on July 2.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Isbel (foot) participates in workout Friday
desc: Kyle Isbel participated in a full team workout on Friday.
impact: Isbel suffered a minor setback last week. If all goes well, he could begin a rehab assignment next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonah Cox (oblique) without timetable to return
desc: Jonah Cox remains without a timetable to return.
impact: Cox was placed on the injured list last week with an oblique strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Victor Bericoto (oblique) without timetable to return
desc: The Giants say Victor Bericoto remains without a timetable to return.
impact: Bericoto was placed on the injured list last week with a left oblique strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Harrison Bader (foot) without timetable to return
desc: Harrison Bader remains without a timetable to return.
impact: Bader has been on the injured list with plantar fasciitis since May 30th.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Chapman (abdomen) to resume swinging Friday
desc: The Giants say Matt Chapman will resume swinging on Friday
impact: If all goes well, Chapman could return at the start of the next homestand for San Francisco.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brenan Hanifee recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Tigers recalled Brenan Hanifee from Triple-A Toledo.
impact: Hanifee will hold a middle-relief role in the Tigers bullpen.
